evidence: We probe the physio-chemical properties of the resulting films with energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX), Rutherford back scattering (RBS), atomic force microscopy (AFM), and scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and show that exfoliation following growth is possible and that the grown film is of high quality. Here, we used XRD measurements to confirm that the substrate retained its bulk crystallinity after overlayer heterogrowth. First, prior to our guided-wave experiments, we measured the optical refractive index of the HfO2/LiNbO3 bilayer structure using spectroscopic ellipsometry from λ =500–1000 nm.
